about: Beside the manifests: where each asset was before the library, the full description when the manifest cuts it at 200 characters, roles and labels, fields no manifest field holds, the measured signature in full and each validator's whole report.

clouds.describeFull: the sky's clouds: a 768 m sheet of night-clouds repeated every 128 m, seen from below (alpha mask: the sky, its stars and the moon show through the gaps); the world hangs it over the arena in the backdrop layer
